title: 第1章 老约翰第2章 灰语森林
slug: 请不要给基础技能附魔奇怪的词条
content_zh:
;;
这里是灰脊丘陵的背风坡，距离喧嚣的黑石镇大约有五公里的泥泞土路，而离那片灰语森林，却只有不到三公里的缓冲带。
坡上有一间小木屋，在远离文明喧嚣的边界，沉默而孤独地屹立着。
屋内，空气潮湿而粘稠，混合着廉价草药烧焦的苦味、陈旧皮革的霉味，以及那一股令人不安的……内脏腐烂的恶臭。
维克多手里端着一盆浑浊的血水，动作麻利地用毛巾擦拭着床上老人额头的冷汗。
他是镇上的孤儿，五年前被性格孤僻的老约翰捡了回来。与其说是收养，不如说是找个便宜的杂役——帮他处理猎物皮毛、煮饭、劈柴。
而三天前，一场突如其来的高烧夺走了原主的生命，现在的维克多，被一个来自地球的灵魂占据。
“咳……咳咳……”
床上，老约翰的胸腔剧烈起伏，每一次呼吸都像是拉动破损的风箱。
这个在镇上以“脾气又臭又硬”著称的老猎人，此刻脆弱得像一张薄纸。他腹部的伤口已经化脓发黑，那是昨天一头变异钢鬃野猪留下的纪念。
那一战，老约翰射瞎了野猪的一只眼，却也赔上了自己的半条命。
“别忙活了……维克多。”
老约翰突然睁开了眼，那双总是浑浊、带着醉意的灰色眼珠，此刻却亮得吓人。他枯瘦如柴的手一把抓住了维克多的手腕。
“那头畜生……来了。”
“谁？”维克多心头一跳。
“那头野猪……它的鼻子比镇上最贪婪的税务官还要灵。”老约翰喘息着，嘴角溢出黑色的血沫，“它循着我伤口腐烂的味道找来了……它是来报仇的。”
维克多下意识地看向紧闭的厚重木门。外面的雷雨声中，似乎真的夹杂着某种沉重的、碾碎泥土的脚步声。
“听着，小子。”
老约翰的声音越来越低，他死死盯着维克多，眼神中流露出一丝从未有过的复杂情绪——那是对死亡的恐惧，更是一种深埋心底几十年的不甘。
“柜子里……那把‘黑木弓’……归你了。”

“我年轻的时候……本来有机会去考‘银星游侠’的……就差一步……就差那一步……”老人的手指痉挛般地收紧，指甲嵌入了维克多的肉里，“后来我老了……腿脚不行了……我也认命了……但这把弓……我不甘心让它就这么烂在土里……”
“拿着它……活下去！”
最后三个字，仿佛耗尽了他灵魂中最后的一滴油。
老约翰的手颓然滑落，重重地砸在床板上。那双灰色的眼睛依旧大睁着，凝视着虚空中的某个点，仿佛那里有着他年轻时未曾触及的荣耀。
屋外，一道惊雷炸响。
维克多呆立在床边。虽然这三天里他和这老头加起来也没说几句话，但此刻，一种唇亡齿寒的巨大恐惧感瞬间将他淹没。
他下意识地伸出手，想要合上老人的双眼。
就在他的指尖触碰到老约翰那逐渐冰冷的额头瞬间——
嗡！
原本昏暗的视野中，忽然跳出了一行散发着幽幽蓝光的字体，清晰得如同视网膜上的烙印。
维克多瞳孔骤缩。
【获得白色词条：未竟的银星】
一股悲凉、决绝的情绪猛地冲击着他的大脑。他仿佛看到了年轻时的老约翰，因为在游侠的考核中，出现了一次失误而折断了长弓，最后只能在雨夜中痛哭的画面。
随即，一个半透明的面板在他眼前展开。
【姓名：维克多】
状态：肾上腺素飙升
【基础属性】
力量：5.3（长期劈柴让你比普通人稍强一点）
敏捷：4.5（稍微跑快点就会左脚绊右脚）
体质：5.5（年轻是唯一的资本）

精神：6.7（两世为人让你保持了理智）
content_en:
;;
This is the leeward slope of the Gray Ridge Hills, about five kilometers away from the bustling Blackstone Town on a muddy dirt road, but there is only a buffer zone of less than three kilometers away from the Gray Whispering Forest.
There is a small wooden house on the slope, standing silently and alone at the border far away from the hustle and bustle of civilization.
Inside, the air was damp and thick, mixed with the bitter smell of burnt cheap herbs, the musty smell of old leather, and the disturbing... stench of rotten internal organs.
Victor held a basin of turbid blood in his hand and quickly wiped the cold sweat from the old man's forehead with a towel.
He is an orphan in the town who was picked up by the withdrawn old John five years ago. Rather than adopting him, it's more like finding a cheap handyman to help him with the furs of his prey, cooking, and chopping firewood.
Three days ago, a sudden high fever took away the life of the original owner. Now Victor is occupied by a soul from the earth.
"Cough... cough cough..."
On the bed, Old John's chest was rising and falling violently, and every breath was like pulling a broken bellows.
This old hunter, who was known in the town for his "stinky and tough temper", was as fragile as a piece of paper at this moment. The wound on his abdomen has turned pus and turned black. It was a souvenir left by a mutated steel-bristle wild boar yesterday.
In that battle, Old John shot out one eye of the wild boar, but also lost half of his life.
"Stop working...Victor."
Old John suddenly opened his eyes. His gray eyes, which were always cloudy and drunken, were frighteningly bright at the moment. His skinny hand grabbed Victor's wrist.
"That beast...is here."
"Who?" Victor's heart skipped a beat.
"That wild boar... its nose is sharper than the greediest tax collector in the town." Old John gasped, black blood foaming from the corner of his mouth. "It followed the rotten smell of my wound to find me... It came for revenge."
Victor subconsciously looked at the closed heavy wooden door. The thunderstorm outside seemed to be mixed with some kind of heavy, earth-crushing footsteps.
"Listen, kid."
Old John's voice became lower and lower. He stared at Victor, his eyes showing a complex emotion that he had never seen before - it was the fear of death, and it was also a kind of unwillingness that had been buried deep in his heart for decades.
"The 'black wood bow' in the cabinet... belongs to you."
"When I was young... I had a chance to take the Silver Star Ranger exam... I was just one step away... I was just one step away..." The old man's fingers tightened convulsively, and his nails dug into Victor's flesh. "Later, when I got old... my legs and feet failed... I accepted my fate... but this bow... I'm not willing to let it rot in the soil like this..."
"Take it... and live!"
The last three words seemed to drain out the last drop of oil in his soul.
Old John's hand slipped down and hit the bed hard. Those gray eyes were still wide open, staring at a certain point in the void, as if there was a glory there that he had not touched when he was young.
Outside the house, a thunder exploded.
Victor stood blankly beside the bed. Although he and the old man had not spoken a few words in the past three days, at this moment, he was instantly overwhelmed by a huge sense of fear.
He subconsciously reached out his hand, trying to close the old man's eyes.
The moment his fingertips touched Old John's increasingly cold forehead——
Buzz!
In the originally dim field of vision, a line of fonts emitting a faint blue light suddenly jumped out, as clear as a brand on the retina.
Victor's pupils shrank suddenly.
[Get the white entry: Unfinished Silver Star]
A sad and decisive emotion suddenly hit his brain. He seemed to see the young old John, who broke his longbow due to a mistake during the ranger assessment, and could only cry bitterly in the rainy night.
Immediately, a translucent panel unfolded before his eyes.

Agility: 4.5 (if you run a little faster, your left foot will trip over your right foot)
Physical fitness: 5.5 (youth is the only capital)
Spirit: 6.7 (two lives have kept you sane)
